@page "/spreadsheet/ribbon-customization"

@using Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet
@using Syncfusion.Blazor.Ribbon
@using System;
@using System.IO;

@*Hidden:Lines*@
@inherits SampleBaseComponent;
@inject NavigationManager NavigationManager
@*End:Hidden*@

<ActionDescription>
    <p>This sample demonstrates the ribbon customization capabilities of Blazor Spreadsheet. You can dynamically customize the ribbon UI through methods or properties to enhance the spreadsheet interface.</p>
    <p><strong>Customization Options:</strong></p>
    <ul>
        <li><strong>Built-in Ribbon Customization:</strong> Control visibility, order, and state of ribbon tabs, groups, and items using properties like <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_RibbonTabItems" aria-label="Navigate to the RibbonTabItems property documentation">RibbonTabItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Ribbon.RibbonTab.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Ribbon_RibbonTab_RibbonGroupItems" aria-label="Navigate to the RibbonGroupItems property documentation">RibbonGroupItems</a>, and <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Ribbon.RibbonGroup.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Ribbon_RibbonGroup_RibbonItems" aria-label="Navigate to the RibbonItems property documentation">RibbonItems</a></li>
        <li><strong>Custom Ribbon Extensions:</strong> Add custom ribbon tabs, groups, and items using <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_CustomRibbonTabs" aria-label="Navigate to the CustomRibbonTabs property documentation">CustomRibbonTabs</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_CustomRibbonGroups" aria-label="Navigate to the CustomRibbonGroups property documentation">CustomRibbonGroups</a>, and <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_CustomRibbonItems" aria-label="Navigate to the CustomRibbonItems property documentation">CustomRibbonItems</a> for extended functionality</li>
        <li><strong>Dynamic Ribbon Methods:</strong> Use methods like <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_HideRibbonItems_System_String_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the HideRibbonItems method documentation">HideRibbonItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_ShowRibbonItems_System_String_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the ShowRibbonItems method documentation">ShowRibbonItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_EnableRibbonItems_System_String_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the EnableRibbonItems method documentation">EnableRibbonItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_DisableRibbonItems_System_String_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the DisableRibbonItems method documentation">DisableRibbonItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AddRibbonItems_System_String_System_Collections_Generic_List_Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SpreadsheetRibbonItem__" aria-label="Navigate to the AddRibbonItems method documentation">AddRibbonItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_HideRibbonTabs_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the HideRibbonTabs method documentation">HideRibbonTabs</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_ShowRibbonTabs_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the ShowRibbonTabs method documentation">ShowRibbonTabs</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_EnableRibbonTabs_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the EnableRibbonTabs method documentation">EnableRibbonTabs</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_DisableRibbonTabs_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the DisableRibbonTabs method documentation">DisableRibbonTabs</a>, and <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AddRibbonTab_Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SpreadsheetCustomRibbonTab_" aria-label="Navigate to the AddRibbonTab method documentation">AddRibbonTab</a> to update the ribbon at runtime</li>
        <li><strong>File Menu Customization:</strong> Customize the file menu with methods like <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_HideFileMenuItems_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the HideFileMenuItems method documentation">HideFileMenuItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_ShowFileMenuItems_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the ShowFileMenuItems method documentation">ShowFileMenuItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_EnableFileMenuItems_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the EnableFileMenuItems method documentation">EnableFileMenuItems</a>, <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_DisableFileMenuItems_System_String_" aria-label="Navigate to the DisableFileMenuItems method documentation">DisableFileMenuItems</a>, and <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/cr/blazor/Syncfusion.Blazor.Spreadsheet.SfSpreadsheet.html#Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_SfSpreadsheet_AddFileMenuItems_System_Collections_Generic_List_Syncfusion_Blazor_Spreadsheet_FileMenuItems_" aria-label="Navigate to the AddFileMenuItems method documentation">AddFileMenuItems</a></li>
    </ul>

    <p>In this demo, the default <strong>Clear</strong> dropdown is hidden from the <strong>Home</strong> tab. A custom tab is added with buttons for various clearing operations:</p>
    <ul>
        <li><strong>Clear All</strong> - Removes both content and formatting from the selected cells.</li>
        <li><strong>Clear Content</strong> - Removes only the cell content while preserving the formatting.</li>
        <li><strong>Clear Format</strong> - Removes only the formatting while preserving the content.</li>
        <li><strong>Clear Links</strong> - Removes hyperlinks from the selected cells.</li>
    </ul>
    <p>This demonstrates customization of the ribbon by hiding built-in items and introducing a dedicated tab with specialized buttons for specific operations.</p>

    <p>For more detailed information about ribbon customization, refer to the <a target="_blank" href="https://help.syncfusion.com/document-processing/excel/spreadsheet/blazor/ribbon-customization" aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet ribbon customization documentation">ribbon customization documentation</a>.</p>

    <p>Looking for the full Blazor Spreadsheet Editor component overview, features, pricing, and documentation? Visit the <a rel="noopener" target='_blank' href='https://www.syncfusion.com/spreadsheet-editor-sdk/blazor-spreadsheet-editor' aria-label="Navigate to the Blazor Spreadsheet Editor FT page">Blazor Spreadsheet Editor component</a> page.</p>
</ActionDescription>
<div class="col-lg-12 control-section">
    <div class="content-wrapper">
        <div class="row">

            <div>
                <SfSpreadsheet DataSource="DataSourceBytes" @ref="_spreadsheetInstance">
                    <SpreadsheetRibbon RibbonItems="@HideClearItem()" CustomRibbonTabs="@GetCustomTabs()">
                    </SpreadsheetRibbon>
                </SfSpreadsheet>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@*Hidden:Lines*@
<style>
    .e-spreadsheet-protection-dialog label,
    .e-spreadsheet-unprotect-dialog label,
    .e-unprotectworkbook-dlg label,
    .e-spreadsheet-name-manager-content label {
        font-weight: normal !important;
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .e-protectworkbook-dlg label {
        font-weight: normal !important;
    }
</style>
@*End:Hidden*@

@code {

    public byte[] DataSourceBytes { get; set; }
    public SfSpreadsheet _spreadsheetInstance { get; set; }

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        @*Server:Block*@
#if !(WASM)
        //Sets the excel file path for initial loading.
        string filePath = "wwwroot/data/spreadsheet/ribbon.xlsx";
        DataSourceBytes = File.ReadAllBytes(filePath);
#endif
        @*End:Server*@

        @*WebAssembly:Block*@
#if (WASM)
    //Sets the excel file path for initial loading.
    string filePath = "";
    DataSourceBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(filePath);
#endif
        @*End:WebAssembly*@
    }

    @*Hidden:Lines*@
    @*WebAssembly:Block*@
#if (WASM)
    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            _spreadsheetInstance.CustomFonts = CustomFonts;
        }
    }

    public List<string> CustomFonts = new List<string>
    {
        "fonts/Arial.TTF",
        "fonts/Calibri.TTF",
        "fonts/Courier New.TTF",
        "fonts/Georgia.TTF",
        "fonts/Algerian.TTF",
        "fonts/Cambria.TTF",
        "fonts/Cambria Math.TTF",
        "fonts/Candara.TTF",
        "fonts/Impact.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe Print.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe UI.TTF",
        "fonts/Segoe Script.TTF",
        "fonts/Symbol.TTF",
        "fonts/Times New Roman.TTF",
        "fonts/Verdana.TTF",
        "fonts/Wingdings.TTF"
    };
#endif
    @*End:WebAssembly*@
    @*End:Hidden*@

    private List<SpreadsheetRibbonItem> HideClearItem()
    {
        return new List<SpreadsheetRibbonItem>
        {
            new SpreadsheetRibbonItem { ItemId = "clear", IsVisible = false }
        };
    }

    private List<SpreadsheetCustomRibbonTab> GetCustomTabs()
    {
        return new List<SpreadsheetCustomRibbonTab>
        {
            new SpreadsheetCustomRibbonTab
            {
                Index = 5,
                Template = CreateClearTab()
            }
        };
    }

    private RenderFragment CreateClearTab()
    {
        return @<RibbonTab ID="clearTab" HeaderText="Clear">
            <RibbonGroups>
                <RibbonGroup ID="clearGroup" HeaderText="Clear Options"
                             Orientation="Syncfusion.Blazor.Ribbon.Orientation.Row">
                    <RibbonCollections>
                        <RibbonCollection>
                            <RibbonItems>
                                <RibbonItem Type="RibbonItemType.Button">
                                    <RibbonButtonSettings Content="Clear All"
                                                              IconCss="e-icons e-trash"
                                                          @onclick="ClearAll">
                                    </RibbonButtonSettings>
                                </RibbonItem>
                                <RibbonItem Type="RibbonItemType.Button">
                                    <RibbonButtonSettings Content="Clear Content"
                                                              IconCss="e-icons e-magic-wand"
                                                          @onclick="ClearContent">
                                    </RibbonButtonSettings>
                                </RibbonItem>
                                <RibbonItem Type="RibbonItemType.Button">
                                    <RibbonButtonSettings Content="Clear Format"
                                                              IconCss="e-icons e-clear-format"
                                                          @onclick="ClearFormat">
                                    </RibbonButtonSettings>
                                </RibbonItem>
                                <RibbonItem Type="RibbonItemType.Button">
                                    <RibbonButtonSettings Content="Clear Links"
                                                          IconCss="e-icons e-link-remove"
                                                          @onclick="ClearLinks">
                                    </RibbonButtonSettings>
                                </RibbonItem>

                            </RibbonItems>
                        </RibbonCollection>
                    </RibbonCollections>
                </RibbonGroup>
            </RibbonGroups>
        </RibbonTab>;
    }

    private async Task ClearAll()
    {
        await _spreadsheetInstance.ClearAsync(ClearOperationType.ClearAll);
    }

    private async Task ClearContent()
    {
        await _spreadsheetInstance.ClearAsync(ClearOperationType.ClearContents);
    }

    private async Task ClearFormat()
    {
        await _spreadsheetInstance.ClearAsync(ClearOperationType.ClearFormats);
    }

    private async Task ClearLinks()
    {
        await _spreadsheetInstance.ClearAsync(ClearOperationType.ClearHyperlinks);
    }
}
